---
title: "Scopus harvester"
---

🧭 Back to [Harvesters Overview](overview.qmd)

> ⚠️ The Scopus harvester requires:
>
> - A valid Scopus API key
> - A valid Scopus institution token
>
> Add these to the environment as `SCOPUS_API_KEY` and `SCOPUS_INST_TOKEN`.

## Data source

The Scopus harvester fetches data from the [Scopus API](https://api.elsevier.com/content/search/scopus).

## Supported identifiers

- scopus (Scopus EID)

## Data conversion

Scopus document types are mapped to RDF classes following the table provided in the
[CRISalid data model documentation](https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1378320388).
